attempted_claim: Let X2 be the smooth toric del Pezzo surface dP2 obtained by blowing up P^2 at the two distinct torus-fixed points p1=[1:0:0] and p2=[0:1:0] for the standard 2-torus action, with H the pullback hyperplane class, E1,E2 the exceptional divisors, and pt,H divisor/point classes as usual. Let beta2=4H-2E1-2E2 in H_2(X2;Z) and let Mbar_{0,2}(X2,beta2) be the genus-zero two-pointed stable-map moduli space with psi-classes psi_1,psi_2 and evaluations ev_1,ev_2. What is the exact rational value of <tau_4(pt),tau_2(H)>_{0,2,beta2}^{X2}=integral over the virtual class of psi_1^4 ev_1^*(pt) cup psi_2^2 ev_2^*(H)? A complete answer is a single explicit rational number N2 asserted to equal that virtual integral for exactly this surface, class, two markings, and mixed point-divisor descendant insertion profile.
decisive_failure: Only preliminary consistency checks were completed (dimension match and invariant-class decomposition count). The full virtual-localization graph sum, code validation against known invariants, torus-weight-independence verification, and any numeric determination of N2 were not performed, so no value for the descendant integral is asserted.
